articles.title: What is Jev? A decision model for software
articles.description: Understand Jev's state, Choice, Score and Noul outputs, how they differ from chat, and which decisions belong in ordinary code.

articles.title: Jev cookbooks, use cases and playgrounds
articles.description: Find official recipes and community demos, then choose a Jev example that matches the decision you need to build and evaluate.

articles.title: Local Jev alternatives: models, adapters and hardware
articles.description: Compare Laya, LEV, Kev and other independent decision tools by weights, protocol, hardware and evaluation, without confusing them with Jev.

articles.title: Jev with Codex, OpenCode, Hermes and Pi
articles.description: Choose between an agent skill, model router, permission hook and context tool. See what Jev does inside a coding agent and what the LLM still does.

articles.title: Jev context compaction: pruning and evidence retention
articles.description: Compare context pruning projects, decide what must survive compaction, and evaluate token savings against the agent's ability to finish its task.

articles.title: Jev in Snowflake, DuckDB and Neo4j
articles.description: Use typed decisions for semantic SQL and graph navigation. Plan permissions, caching, evidence and review before adding model calls to data pipelines.

articles.title: Jev semantic search, Jevgrep and RAG reranking
articles.description: Separate retrieval from relevance decisions, choose a Jevgrep repository, and design an answerability gate that keeps RAG grounded in source passages.

articles.title: Document classification with Jev: labels and review
articles.description: Design exclusive categories, independent tags and a review queue. Start with a typed Python example and test unreadable, ambiguous and hostile documents.

articles.title: Jev guardrails, PII checks and agent permissions
articles.description: Design model-assisted risk checks with deterministic permission boundaries, review paths and failure handling. Compare the different Jev Guard projects.

articles.title: JevBench, JevArena and decision-model evaluation
articles.description: Read benchmarks without mixing datasets or model versions. Measure accuracy, calibration, review coverage, latency and cost on your own workload.

articles.title: Jev computer use, visual experiments and game agents
articles.description: See how text-only Jev fits browser, voice, game and robot loops, and why community visual models need separate evidence and hardware checks.

articles.title: Jev desktop apps, mobile assistants and UI tools
articles.description: Find Jarvis, office assistants, Mac bridges, call visualizers and browser extensions. Compare client permissions and which model actually writes replies.

articles.title: Jev trading projects: architecture and research limits
articles.description: Understand Jev Trader's decision loop and how to evaluate trading experiments with independent risk limits, execution records and realistic test conditions.

articles.title: Jev API and SDK guide: TypeSafe and OpenRouter
articles.description: Find the official SDKs and request shape, distinguish OpenRouter Decisions from chat routing, and check community Java, Rust and adapter compatibility.

faqPages.title: Jev FAQ: official access, downloads and integrations

faqPages.lead: Find the right entry point for Jev, understand which component you need, and follow the relevant guide for your workflow.

faqPages.title: Jev IA: site oficial, acesso e dúvidas frequentes
faqPages.description: Encontre o site oficial do Jev, o console da TypeSafe e os SDKs. Entenda a diferença entre o modelo, apps da comunidade e alternativas locais.
faqPages.lead: O Jev é um modelo de decisões da TypeSafe AI. O acesso oficial começa no site e no console da TypeSafe; o JevHunt reúne projetos independentes da comunidade.
